Are you an experienced CE driver who enjoys being on the road and likes variety? For a growing transport company in Desteldonk (Ghent), we are looking for a motivated CE driver for Benelux distribution.

You will work in a professional environment with a clear schedule, fixed arrangements and personal support. Safety, reliability and quality service are key. After successfully completing the Ecodrive, you will also receive a company car for private use.

Your job

• Carry out distribution trips throughout the Benelux
• Drive to a variety of destinations, including East Flanders, Limburg and locations across the border
• Transport goods safely and on time
• Regularly load and unload goods yourself via the loading dock or curtain side
• Warehouse staff can take over loading and unloading when needed
• Provide professional and customer-oriented service
• Drive your own fixed truck, departing daily from Desteldonk
• Possibility to work for a fixed customer, providing extra structure and regularity

• You have a valid CE driving licence and some initial experience as a driver
• You are punctual, responsible and customer-oriented
• You work safely and professionally
• You are flexible and enjoy variety in your work
• You speak Dutch or English
• You are motivated and proud of your profession

Are you a CE driver who enjoys being on the road but wants to be home every evening? For a growing transport company in Desteldonk (Ghent), we are looking for a motivated CE driver for shuttle and regional work.

You can count on a clear schedule, a stable work structure and daily departure from Desteldonk. After successfully completing the Ecodrive, you will also receive a company car for private use.

Your job

• Carry out shuttle and distribution trips for various customers (no shops, only industrial companies)
• Mainly drive within the Ghent region
• Transport goods safely and on time
• Loading and unloading is only occasionally done by you via the loading dock or curtain side; warehouse staff usually take care of this
• Provide professional and customer-oriented service
• Possibility to work for a fixed customer, offering extra structure and regularity
• Start each day from Desteldonk
• No overnight stays – home every evening

• You have a valid CE driving licence and some initial experience as a driver
• You are punctual, responsible and customer-oriented
• You work safely and professionally
• You are flexible and enjoy variety in your work
• You speak Dutch or English
• You are motivated and proud of your profession
• You are available to start between 5:00 and 6:00 AM

Are you looking for an active night shift job in a cold (-22°C) and stable working environment?
Then this might be your new challenge!

You will be working for a rapidly growing logistics company that distributes frozen products.

As an Order Picker, you are an indispensable link in the logistics process. You ensure that orders are prepared and shipped without errors.

- You collect frozen products using a pick list and scanner.
- You stack boxes correctly on pallets according to the instructions.
- You prepare orders for shipment and place pallets in the correct location.
- You work with an electric pallet truck.
- You strictly follow safety and quality rules.
- Vaardigheden:
You have experience as an order picker or logistics employee.
You are familiar with working with an electric pallet truck.
You can work without any problems in a frozen environment of -22°C.
You enjoy active work.
You work accurately, are reliable, and think in terms of the team.

- Attesten:
Certificate for electric pallet truck is a plus, but not mandatory.

- Opleidingsvereisten:
No diploma required.

- Talenkennis:
Good knowledge of English

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

The Production/Finishing Department has an exciting opportunity for a results-driven Process Engineer.

Purpose of the Role

You will develop and implement manufacturing methods to ensure production is carried out in the safest, highest-quality, and most cost-effective manner.

Working from within the production environment, you will collaborate closely with Quality, Engineering & Maintenance, Supply Chain, Business teams, and other stakeholders to improve safety, quality, delivery performance, and productivity. 

Key Responsibilities
 
• Investigate and resolve issues arising during the manufacturing process. 
• Drive operational excellence initiatives by identifying improvement opportunities, reducing losses, optimizing processes, and improving equipment reliability. 
• Identify and analyze process improvement opportunities to enhance productivity, quality, safety, and cost efficiency, and lead improvement projects across production and supporting departments. 
• Facilitate and support change management activities. 
• Ensure that improvements are properly documented, standardized, and embedded within operational processes. 
Profile / Qualifications
 
• Master's degree or an experienced Professional Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Industrial Sciences, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or a related technical field. 
• Proven experience in a manufacturing or production environment. 
• Experience with process analysis, data analysis, and performance management. 
• Knowledge of Power BI, OT/IT systems, Six Sigma, or similar analytical tools is considered an asset. 
• Fluent in Dutch and English. 
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. 
• Hands-on mentality with the ability to translate ideas into practical improvements. 
• Effective communication skills with the ability to engage a variety of stakeholders. 
• Ability to work both independently and within multidisciplinary teams.

As a Global Operations specialist, you will manage the full lifecycle of leasing contracts.

 

Client Details

 
Our client is a leading international organization specializing in technology lifecycle management and financing solutions, supporting businesses across a wide range of industries. With a strong global presence and a collaborative culture, they offer innovative services that help companies optimize the use, management, and renewal of their technology assets.

 

Description

 
As a Global Operations Specialist, you will ensure the efficient administration of leasing contracts throughout their lifecycle. Your responsibilities include;

• Processing orders and purchases
• Managing leasing schedules and invoices
• Maintaining customer and supplier data
• Coordinating deliveries and returns
• Handling documentation
• Providing operational support to customers while driving process improvements.

 

 
The ideal candidate is fluent in Dutch, French, and English and possesses strong administrative and organizational skills. You have excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, are comfortable working with complex systems, and bring experience from an international environment. You are proactive, detail-oriented, able to prioritize effectively, and capable of working both independently and collaboratively to deliver high-quality results.

For our client in the Kortrijk region, we are looking for a motivated Carpet Finishing Operator to strengthen our team on the finishing line.

 

• Cutting and finishing carpets to size

• Processing carpets on the finishing line

• Carrying out quality checks

• Attaching fringes when necessary

• Applying labels to carpets

• Ensuring a neat and high-quality finish

Job Requirements:

• You are precise and enjoy working with your hands

• You have an eye for quality and attention to detail

• You can work independently, but you are also a team player

• Experience in carpets, textiles or garment manufacturing is a plus

• Experience is not required: motivation and a positive work attitude are important

• You speak Dutch, French or English

We are looking for an experienced and motivated Packaging Supervisor to join the  team on the night shift. 

Your responsibilities:

• Supervise and coordinate the packaging team during the night shift.

• Ensure that packaging activities are carried out efficiently and according to production planning.

• Follow and maintain the work schedule

• Lead and coordinate team members

• Actively contribute to the work on the floor

• Work responsibly, flexibly, and independently

 

 

Requirements:

• Previous experience in a packaging, production, or supervisory role.

• Strong organizational and leadership skills.

• Ability to work independently and make decisions under pressure.

• Willingness to work night shifts.

• Experience in a food production or manufacturing environment is an advantage.

• Good command of English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

As a 
Claims Handler, you will manage maritime and transport claims from A to Z. You will act as a key contact for our clients and coordinate the different parties involved throughout the claims process.
 

Your day-to-day work includes assessing incoming claims, coordinating surveys, reviewing documentation and reports, investigating the cause and extent of damage, calculating claim amounts and preparing final reports. You will also maintain close contact with brokers, exporters, insurers, surveyors, lawyers and other partners, representing the interests of our clients throughout the process.
 

The role offers a high degree of 
autonomy and 
responsibility, combined with an international and varied range of contacts.

We are looking for a proactive and organised person with an analytical mindset and strong communication skills. You enjoy taking ownership of cases, working with different stakeholders and finding practical solutions for clients.
 

Experience or knowledge in 
claims, insurance, logistics, transport or the 
 maritime sector is an advantage, but is not a requirement.
 

We are equally interested in candidates with a relevant background and a strong willingness to learn.
 

You are comfortable working in an international environment and have a strong command of 
English, both written and spoken.

jobs.occupation: BNP Paribas Fortis - IT & Cyber Risk Specialist
jobs.description:
Your Job at a glance

Ready to Shape the Future of Cybersecurity in Banking?

At the heart of BNP Paribas Fortis, the Centre of Expertise Security (CoE Security) drives innovation in secure solutions, designing, implementing, and maintaining trusted, cutting-edge protections for our teams and clients.

As an IT Cyber Risk Manager, you will operate at the core of our cybersecurity strategy, connecting, influencing, and collaborating across the entire bank. Within our 'Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)' team, you will work closely with IT and Business Units to redefine Operational Risk Management, with a sharp focus on IT and Cyber Security.

This is not just a risk management role - it's an opportunity to:

 
• 
  
   
• Engage diverse stakeholders, from technical teams to C-level executives, across all areas of BNP Paribas Fortis.
   
• Drive creative solutions, transforming complex cyber risks into practical, forward-thinking strategies.
   
• Shape a resilient future by proactively managing cyber risks to strengthen the bank's defenses.
  
 

If you thrive in a dynamic, cross-functional environment where innovation and collaboration are key, this is your chance to make a tangible impact in banking cybersecurity

 

And in detail

Your Key Role as IT & Cyber Risk Specialist :

You serve as the critical link between technical risks, business priorities, and strategic decisions, ensuring IT and cybersecurity risks are proactively identified, analyzed, and translated into actionable strategies-fully aligned with the bank's objectives.

 

Why this role stands out:

 
• 
  
   
• Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Tribes, Functions, and Business Units, clearly articulating risks to both technical teams and leadership—enabling data-driven decision-making.
   
• Proactive risk intelligence: From Shadow IT exposures to operational vulnerabilities, you assess, prioritize, and drive mitigation, delivering practical solutions that balance security with business continuity.
   
• Strategic advisory: Provide targeted recommendations to IT and business stakeholders, ensuring risks are managed without compromising operational goals.
   
• Enterprise-wide alignment: Report risks, trends, and insights to Cyber Security, IT, and Business Management, while sharing best practices across the BNP Paribas Group—reinforcing a unified risk posture.
   
• Process optimization: Leverage your expertise to refine risk management methods and tools, ensuring they remain efficient, scalable, and future-ready."
  
 

 

Your talents and skills

 
• 
  
   
• Risk-to-Solution Mindset: You break down complex IT and cybersecurity challenges, turning them into clear, actionable insights for leadership—viewing risks as solvable challenges, not just warnings.
   
• Bank-Specific Acumen: Deep understanding of BNP Paribas Fortis' businesses, functions, and strategic goals, ensuring risk management aligns with our priorities.
   
• Technical + Risk Expertise: Hands-on experience in IT infrastructure, architecture, and security, blending technical knowledge with risk awareness to design practical solutions—not just identify risks.
   
• Multilingual Communication: Fluent in French or Dutch + professional English, with strong written and verbal persuasion skills. You adapt...
  
 
...

For a company in the Tielt region, active in the food industry, we are looking for a motivated and reliable Packaging Operator.

Your responsibilities:

• Operating and monitoring packaging machines and equipment.

• Preparing products for the packaging process.

• You like working with vegetables

• Checking the quality of packaged products.

• Monitoring the packaging and production process.

• Solving minor machine issues and reporting technical problems to the supervisor.

• Keeping the workplace clean and organized.

• Following all safety, hygiene, and quality procedures.

 

 

Your profile:

• Experience in production or machine operation is an advantage.

• Willingness to work during the day

• Reliable, accurate and motivated.

• Able to work independently as well as part of a team.

• Good work ethic and a responsible attitude.

• Besides Polish or Romanian of other language,  you also  have a good knowledge of English

What will you do?

• Clean the interiors of tankers, bulk trucks, container trucks and other vehicles.
• Operate a forklift to move materials and goods.
• Ensure that cleaning orders are carried out correctly.
• Carefully monitor the work during cleaning activities.
• Refill cleaning products in a timely manner.
• Perform general cleaning and maintenance of the workplace.
• Comply with applicable safety and quality regulations.
• Work together with colleagues to complete cleaning assignments efficiently.

Who are you?

• You are characterised by motivation, a willingness to learn and a hands-on mentality.
• Speaking Dutch, English or German is not a problem for you.
• Good physical fitness is important, as this is a physically demanding job; candidates must not suffer from back problems.
• You are comfortable working at heights or in smaller, enclosed spaces.
• Working safely and using the necessary personal protective equipment is second nature to you.
• Experience operating a forklift is required; a forklift certificate is an advantage, but not essential.
• You do not wear glasses, or you are willing to wear contact lenses.
• Basic knowledge of computer programs is an advantage.
• You are able to work both independently and as part of a team.
• Accuracy and a strong sense of responsibility are among your strengths.
• Your own means of transport is essential, as the workplace is not accessible by public transport.
• Experience in industrial cleaning or the cleaning sector is an advantage, but motivation is the priority.

jobs.occupation: Kitchen Help Industrial Kitchen - Aalter - 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or a perfectly cooked roast beef: you’ll be licking your fingers and thumbs. And in this role, you’ll make sure others can do the same. In our kitchen, we create dishes that would make grandmothers jealous—but on an industrial scale, in large quantities.
 

We’re looking for a Kitchen Help for a food company in Aalter!
 

Hygiene is crucial for a kitchen staff member. That’s why you’ll ensure every day that your work methods and the final products meet all standards.
 

You’ll also follow safety regulations to the letter. You’ll do everything in your power to guarantee both quality and safety. 
 

 

Who are you?

• You have experience as a cook in a commercial or industrial kitchen. Do you also have experience in a production environment? If so, that’s a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system.
• The early shift starts at 4:30 a.m. and runs until 12:30 p.m.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 p.m. and runs until 8:00 p.m.
• You know how to operate machinery or are willing to undergo training for this.
• Physical work doesn’t deter you, and you’re hands-on.
• You work with great precision and are flexible and able to handle stress.
• You’re a good communicator, enjoy variety, and like working in a team.
• You speak Dutch or English well.

Searching for a job in Sales? Eager to learn everything from the bottom to the top?
Want to work in a company who's values are doing the right thing, doing waht is best for the customer and driven in improvements and innovations?

This internationaly active production company is looking for a highly self-motivated, results oriented and solutions driven Management Trainee with a general interest in all levels of a business and a general interest in developing new technologies. After completing the management trainee program, you will be assigned to a full-time position in Sales.

The client's management trainee program is designed for recent university graduates who are highly motivated and have the potential to excel as future global leaders at the company. The training program is customized to meet the skills of the employee along with the needs of the company.

It offers challenging work assignments along with hands on training in manufacturing, quality control, administration, sales & marketing, and logistics. You will be exposed to all areas of the business and learn by successfully completing various projects in the different departments.

• A master or bachelor degree.
• If you have already strong sales skills for new account development that would be an advantage.
• 2 years of previous work experiences.
• A fluent pen and verbal skills in English and Dutch. Any additional languages would be great.
• Able to work autonomously, in a structured and efficient way.
• Strong sense of urgency, listening, communication and organizational skills.

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry in Zottegem, is currently looking for a motivated operator to join the packaging department in a 2 shift system.

What will your responsibilities be?
As a packaging operator, you are an essential link in our client’s production process.
Multitasking, precision and working at a fast pace are your strengths.

Your responsibilities:
 
• You will mainly be responsible for packaging the finished products. 
• You will regularly carry out quality checks. 
• You will ensure that packaging materials are supplied to the production line. 
• You will set up your machine and keep it running smoothly. 
• Labelling and logistical tasks will also be part of your responsibilities. 
• Finally, you will ensure a clean and tidy working environment.
The working hours are from Monday till Friday in a 2 shiftsystem:
early shift: 06:00–14:00
late shift: 14:00–22:00
 
• You have some previous experience in a production environment, preferably in the food industry. 
• You are available to start soon. 
• You speak Dutch and/or English fluently. 
• You are conscientious and enjoy working efficiently. 
• You are an excellent multitasker. 
• You can work well both independently and as part of a team. 
• Working at a fast pace is not a problem for you. 
• You are enthusiastic and eager to learn. 
• You are specifically looking for a job in 2 shifts. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.
